ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the gear/settings button (data-testid=view-store-bf406578-1c57-4449-ab13-66736f3c2842) on the 'Gala Test 2026 UI' event store row does NOT open the detail Dialog within 6 seconds — [role='dialog'] count remains 0 and body text length does not grow. The SAME flow on the creator store 'Flow-B Final' (1bffa147-7129-4871-ab37-682c16e6f88a) DOES open the dialog correctly and renders payouts. Suggests handleViewStore is throwing or awaiting indefinitely on the event-specific fetches (questionnaire / event-setup-checklist) before setIsDetailDialogOpen(true). This is the exact regression Phase 1 was meant to guard against ('Event Questionnaire tab black-screen risk').

action_items: HIGH: Investigate why 'Gala Test 2026 UI' (event store, id bf406578-1c57-4449-ab13-66736f3c2842) detail dialog does not open when its gear button is clicked from /webstores. Suspect handleViewStore() awaits or unhandled rejection on the event-specific endpoints (GET /api/webstores/v2/{id}/questionnaire or /event-setup-checklist) before setIsDetailDialogOpen(true). Move the open-state setter BEFORE the optional event fetches, or wrap them in Promise.allSettled with proper try/catch so the dialog opens even when those endpoints fail. Also add data-testid='store-detail-dialog' on the Dialog so future tests can detect dialog visibility reliably.

Verify Customer Portal credentials demo-fundraiser@rysoccer.example / TestPortal123! still authenticate against /api/portal/auth/login in the current preview DB; if not, refresh the seed and update /app/memory/test_credentials.md.

rca_of_the_issue: Gala event-store detail dialog black-screen-risk regression: handleViewStore in /app/frontend/src/pages/Webstores.js (line ~600) is async and likely awaits event-specific endpoints (questionnaire / event-setup-checklist) BEFORE setIsDetailDialogOpen(true) at line 707. Any rejection in those fetches blocks the dialog from ever opening — matching the observed behavior where the SAME click flow opens dialogs for non-event stores (Flow-B Final) but stays silent for event store Gala. Reproduction: navigate /webstores as admin → click gear icon on Gala Test 2026 UI row → wait 6s → no [role='dialog'] appears. Mitigation: open dialog optimistically and wrap event fetches in Promise.allSettled with defensive try/catch and per-card error states, OR move setIsDetailDialogOpen(true) before any await. Also add data-testid='store-detail-dialog' to the Dialog for reliable assertion.
